entries.review: Top-left: naturally ringlike stone with blind hollow seated between two rough roots.
Top-middle: wild tinder fungus lodged in a tree fork and holding a small ember.
Top-right: rough clay slab with a crooked finger path and three shallow thumb hollows, no writing.
Middle-left: curved natural claw at a tree fork worrying loose a coarse fiber knot.
Middle-middle: broken shell suspended on two forked twigs and dripping into a puddle.
Middle-right: lumpy unfired clay plug with pinch nub pressed into a fallen branch split.
Bottom-left: differently shaped rough stone flakes arranged along an exposed root fork.
Bottom-middle: naturally crooked stick reaching into a narrow boulder crevice.
Bottom-right: loose varied-leaf bundle tied and tucked into a tree fork with air gaps.
